name: 落地页
description: 从一份简报做出单页网站：简报（人）→ 结构 → 文案 → 照片（可空）→ 生成网页 → 检查。缺图用色块，页面不访问网络。 / Build a one-page site from a brief: brief (person) → structure → copy → photos (optional) → build → check. A missing image becomes a color block, and the page loads nothing from the network.

language.description: 输出语言：zh 中文，en English。决定结构、文案、页面上的固定文字和检查报告 / Output language: zh or en. Sets the structure, copy, fixed page text and the check report

product.description: 产品名称，例如：箱栖 / Product name, e.g. BoxNest

audience.description: 访问者是谁，例如：养猫的人 / Who the visitor is, e.g. people who live with a cat

goal.description: 希望访问者做什么，例如：留下邮箱 / What the visitor should do, e.g. leave an email

stages.name: 简报
stages.description: 写下卖点、语气、必须出现的事实，以及不要说的话。模板里有一份虚构的箱栖简报。 / Write the selling points, tone, facts that must appear, and things not to say. The template ships a fictional BoxNest brief.

executor.instructions: 编辑 brief.md：卖点、语气、必须写上的事实、不要说的话。示例是虚构的「箱栖」，用之前换成你的产品。 / Edit brief.md: selling points, tone, must-have facts, and things not to say. The sample is the fictional product BoxNest; replace it before you use it.

stages.name: 结构
stages.description: 把页面分成区块。每个区块有用途、要点，以及建议的图片文件名。 / Split the page into blocks. Each block has a purpose, key points, and a suggested image file name.

stages.name: 文案
stages.description: 为每个区块写标题、正文和按钮文字，和 structure.json 一一对应。 / Write each block's heading, body and button text, one to one with structure.json.

stages.name: 照片
stages.description: 按结构里的 image 放图片。缺的图会变成带说明的色块，空文件夹也可以。 / Add images named from each block's image field. A missing image becomes a color block with a caption, so an empty folder works.

executor.instructions: 把图片放进 images/，文件名用 structure.json 里每个区块的 image，例如 hero.jpg。没有图片就留着空的 images/，生成时会用色块加说明。 / Put images in images/, named after each block's image field in structure.json, e.g. hero.jpg. Leave images/ empty if you have none; the build uses a color block and a caption.

stages.name: 生成
stages.description: 写成 site/index.html 和 site/style.css，并把用到的图片复制到 site/images/。手机宽度、深色模式，文字都会转义，不引用网络。 / Write site/index.html and site/style.css, and copy used images into site/images/. Phone width, dark mode, escaped text, and no network requests.

stages.name: 检查
stages.description: 检查缺替代文本的图片、空链接、跳级的标题、过长的区块，以及文案里有但页面上没有的区块。 / Check images missing alt, empty links, skipped heading levels, overly long blocks, and blocks present in the copy but missing from the page.
